about: Calendar-quarter series for the six companies added to the dashboard slide (Oracle, Apple, Tesla, CoreWeave, Nebius, SpaceX), 2023Q1-2026Q3. Oracle, Apple, Tesla, CoreWeave and SpaceX are read from SEC XBRL companyfacts downloaded on 2026-11-10; Nebius, which files no quarterly XBRL, is read from the company's own quarterly results releases. Nothing is estimated or interpolated: a quarter that the sources do not give is null.
units: USD billion, 3 decimals; ratios in % (interestCoverage in times).

definitions.calendar mapping: each fiscal quarter is shown under the calendar quarter whose end is nearest to its own end (Oracle: Feb/May/Aug/Nov month-ends; Apple: last Saturday of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec); 'end' is the actual fiscal quarter-end date
definitions.revenueGrowth: revenue / revenue of the same quarter one year earlier - 1 (%)
definitions.fcf: operating cash flow - cash purchases of property and equipment of the quarter (finance-lease principal not deducted)
definitions.interestCoverage: operating income / interest expense of the same quarter (times); negative when the quarter has an operating loss
definitions.netAssets: assets - liabilities = stockholders' equity + noncontrolling interests + temporary (mezzanine) equity
definitions.debtRatio: liabilities / netAssets at the quarter end (%); null when netAssets <= 0. For a filer with no noncontrolling or temporary equity this is liabilities / stockholders' equity, the definition used in research_quarterly_fin.json

method: Duration items: the discrete 3-month fact as reported; otherwise fiscal-YTD differencing (fiscal Q4 = full year - nine months); otherwise YTD through the next quarter minus that quarter's 3-month fact. Instant items: the fact dated at the fiscal quarter end. Most recently filed fact wins (restatements). Liabilities: the Liabilities tag; Oracle does not tag it, so Assets - (StockholdersEquity + MinorityInterest).

gaps.Oracle: 2023Q1: assets - liabilities is negative (-1.912), so debtRatio is null.
gaps.Apple: Interest expense is tagged only through fiscal 2023 (quarter ended 2023-09-30); interestExpense and interestCoverage are null from 2023Q4 on.
gaps.CoreWeave: Listed 2025-03. No quarterly facts for 2023 (only the full year), so 2023Q1-Q4 are null and revenueGrowth starts in 2025Q1. Assets and Liabilities are tagged from 2024-12-31 on. 2026Q3 had not been reported when the data were downloaded (2026-11-10).
gaps.SpaceX: Listed 2026-06. The 10-Qs for 2026Q2 and 2026Q3 carry XBRL facts (with prior-year comparatives); the first quarters, full-year 2025 and the balance sheets at 2024-12-31 and 2026-03-31 are read in the prospectus (Form 424B4) published on the company's investor-relations site, so 2025Q4 is full year minus nine months and the second quarters' cash flows are six months minus the first quarter. No document prints quarterly results for 2024, so revenueGrowth starts in 2026Q1, and no balance sheet is printed at 2025-03-31, 2025-06-30 or 2025-09-30, so debtRatio is null for those quarters. 2025Q3 capex is 6.881 by year-to-date subtraction; the earnings release prints 6.880 (segment rounding).
gaps.Nebius: 2026Q3 had not been published when the data were gathered (2026-11-10; the company scheduled it for 2026-11-12). 2023 quarters and the 2024-03-31 balance sheet exist only for the former Yandex N.V. group or on a basis that includes Toloka, so they are null; revenueGrowth therefore starts in 2025Q1. The releases show no interest-expense line before 2025Q2. 2024Q1 is the first half minus the second quarter (the release for that quarter was issued by Yandex N.V. in RUB). 2025Q3-2026Q2 are as first reported and unaudited: the audited FY2025 accounts show an operating loss 15.5 larger and net income 19.2 lower than the sum of the four quarterly releases, and the quarter that absorbs the difference has not been published. Operating cash flow for the 2025 quarters sums to 401.7 against 401.9 for the year (rounding in the releases).
